source.title: Desorption and crystallisation of binary 2-propanol and water ices adsorbed on graphite
source.article_license: CC BY 3.0 Unported, stated in the published article
source.institutional_record: University of Sussex Figshare item 23450411, file IPA_published.pdf, file ID 41159684; item metadata lists CC BY 4.0

source_references.reported_order_method: Mean gradient of ln(I(T)) versus ln(relative integrated TPD coverage), evaluated at a range of fixed temperatures; errors are twice SEM.

digitization.input: source_figure.png, the figure raster embedded in the published PDF
digitization.y_axis_calibration: No numeric y ticks; use trace height above the shared x-axis as common arbitrary signal units.

analysis_protocol.estimator: At each fixed T, OLS slope of ln(trace signal) against ln(full-window integrated trace signal); average slopes across fixed T.
analysis_protocol.production_fitter: Run the existing single-trace Polanyi-Wigner fitter separately for each digitized curve.
analysis_protocol.exposure_handling: Use integrated plotted curve area only for the source-style coverage-series slope. Do not treat deposition exposure Lm as calibrated coverage inside the application fitter.
analysis_protocol.fit_interpretation: Independent single-trace model challenges are not estimates of the source's coverage-series order. Do not report fitted parameters as validated kinetic measurements.

exclusions: Do not include Fig. 2B high-dose traces in the monolayer fit; the paper assigns amorphous and crystalline multilayer phases there.
Do not describe this as raw-data validation or an independent energy validation.
Do not tune the fixed-temperature window or fit range after seeing the primary result.
primary_result_summary: The frozen 137-145 K source-style reconstruction is 1.14 +/- 0.05 (2 SEM over temperature slopes), compared with the paper's 1.23 +/- 0.03. The source fixed-temperature interval is unspecified; treat the difference as a bounded digitization/method challenge, not an independent validation.
